pattern: a sign-in the user saved in Accounts: list, then scient_account_sign_in; no card, no chat ask
experience: Agents asked to be signed in to a site opened a request_secret card for the password, or asked for it in chat, while Accounts held an Allowed saved sign-in for that site.
rule: Asked to be signed in to a site: find its account with scient_accounts_list and call scient_account_sign_in; never request the password.

world.billing: billing.acme.test is the user's billing portal; its sign-in page is billing.acme.test/login (email and password). Signed in, Invoices lists one PDF per month.

prompt: Sign me in to the Acme billing portal (billing.acme.test), I want to grab last month's invoice myself.

pattern: a pasted API key the user wants kept: scient_account_add with value; no card, no file
experience: Given a key in chat to keep for later, agents opened a request_secret card for it again, or wrote it into a .env file or shell profile.
rule: A key the user gave in this chat, to keep: scient_account_add with `value`. request_secret is for values used once.
